_comment: Example entry for an MCP client. Replace the two paths with the absolute
paths on your machine: `command` must be an interpreter that can import
sage.all (Sage's own python), and `args[0]` is this server's sage_mcp.py.
On a Debian/Ubuntu sage install that is usually /usr/bin/python3 and
/opt/sage/bin/sage; with conda it is <env>/bin/python.  install.sh fills
